research_claims.statement: Displacement is final position minus initial position on a declared one-dimensional axis.
conditions: A common frame and axis convention are declared.
edge_cases: Different paths may have the same displacement if endpoints match.

research_claims.statement: For a velocity-time graph, signed area over a time interval represents displacement over that interval.
conditions: Velocity and time axes are identified and the velocity sign convention is preserved.
edge_cases: Area below the time axis contributes negative displacement.

worked_reasoning.summary: Start at -2 m and finish at +7 m: displacement = 7 - (-2) = +9 m.
A velocity-time graph with +12 m signed area and -5 m signed area has net displacement +7 m.

misconceptions.wrong_model: distance and displacement are always equal
misconceptions.repair_logic: compare two different paths with identical endpoints
distinguish instantaneous velocity from accumulated signed area
